## Introduction

This post explores homeless shelter locations in Vancouver using Python. 
I will examine the shelter data, summarize some of its characteristics, 
and create a visualization of the results.

## About the Dataset

This dataset is from the City of Vancouver Open Data Portal. It contains information about homeless shelter locations in the City of Vancouver. I will use this dataset to create summaries and visualizations.

**Dataset:** Homeless Shelter Locations  
**Publisher:** City of Vancouver  
**Data Owner:** City of Vancouver  
**Licence:** Open Government Licence - Vancouver  
**Source:** [City of Vancouver Open Data Portal](https://opendata.vancouver.ca/explore/dataset/homeless-shelter-locations/)

:::{.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Summary of Findings

The analysis below summarizes the homeless shelter locations in Vancouver using tables and a graph. Some key findings are:

1. Most shelters serve adults of all genders, with 12 out of 17 shelters in this category.
2. Most shelters do not allow pets. Only 4 out of 17 shelters allow pets.
3. Carts are allowed at only 2 out of 17 shelters.
4. The shelters are located across several Geo Local Areas in Vancouver, with the largest number located in Downtown.

The tables below summarize shelter categories, meal support, pets, and carts. The final graph shows the number of shelters by Geo Local Area.
:::

## Import packages
```{python}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

import pandas as pd
import altair as alt
```

## Import Dataset
```{python}
from pathlib import Path

project_root = Path.cwd()

while not (project_root / "_quarto.yml").exists():
    project_root = project_root.parent

shelters = pd.read_excel(
    project_root / "data" / "homeless-shelter-locations.xlsx"
)

shelters
```

```{python}
shelters.shape
shelters.columns
```

## Shelter Categories
The following table summarizes the number of shelters in each category.

```{python}
category_table = shelters["CATEGORY"].value_counts().reset_index()
category_table.columns = ["Category", "Number of Shelters"]
category_table
```

## Meal Support
The following table summarizes whether the shelters provide meal support.

```{python}
meals_table = shelters["MEALS"].value_counts().reset_index()
meals_table.columns = ["Meal Support", "Number of Shelters"]
meals_table
```

## Pets Allowed
The following table summarizes whether pets are allowed at the shelters.

```{python}
pets_table = shelters["PETS"].value_counts().reset_index()
pets_table.columns = ["Pets Allowed", "Number of Shelters"]
pets_table
```

## Carts Allowed
The following table summarizes whether carts are allowed at the shelters.

```{python}
carts_table = shelters["CARTS"].value_counts().reset_index()
carts_table.columns = ["Carts Allowed", "Number of Shelters"]
carts_table
```

## Shelters by Geo Local Area
The following graph shows the number of homeless shelters in each Geo Local Area.

```{python}
geo_table = shelters["Geo Local Area"].value_counts().reset_index()
geo_table.columns = ["Geo Local Area", "Number of Shelters"]
geo_table
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-geo-local-area
#| fig-cap: "Number of homeless shelters by Geo Local Area in Vancouver."

chart = alt.Chart(geo_table).mark_bar().encode(
    x=alt.X("Number of Shelters:Q", title="Number of Shelters"),
    y=alt.Y("Geo Local Area:N", sort="-x", title="Geo Local Area"))

chart
```
